reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior secured loan of up to RON 347,771,000 (equivalent to EUR 68.6 million) to NewCold Romania SRL including i) committed tranche RON 182,771,000 and ii) uncommitted tranche RON 165,000,000, a limited liability company incorporated in Romania, to support the development of a large-scale, automated cold storage facilities with capacity for 75,400 pallets in Bucharest, and a planned future expansion. It will be the first fully automated cold storage facility operated by a third-party logistics provider in Romania. The Project has been approved under the EBRD InvestEU Framework for Sustainable Transition. The facility is expected to strengthen Romania's food supply chain by improving storage efficiency, reducing food waste, and supporting the digitalisation of logistics infrastructure. Local suppliers will benefit from higher operational standards, including advanced traceability and performance monitoring systems.
